title: scale vertices
explanation:
### Description

This example scales vertex glyphs by a data array. Two vertices are drawn as circles whose size reflects a "Scales" array, and whose color is driven by a lookup table with yellow and green entries. vtkGlyph3D places scaled circle glyphs at each vertex position.

**dataset → input → filter → layout → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → output**

- [vtkFloatArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkFloatArray.html) stores the per-vertex scale values.
- [vtkGlyph3D](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGlyph3D.html) places scaled circle glyphs at vertex positions.
- [vtkGlyphSource2D](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGlyphSource2D.html) creates the circle glyph shape.
- [vtkGraphLayout](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGraphLayout.html) applies the force-directed layout strategy.
- [vtkGraphToPolyData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGraphToPolyData.html) converts graph to polydata.
- [vtkIntArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkIntArray.html) stores per-vertex color indices.
- [vtkLookupTable](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkLookupTable.html) maps integer indices to colors.
- [vtkMutableUndirectedGraph](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkMutableUndirectedGraph.html) builds the undirected graph.
